sloka: कपे लाघवयुक्तो ऽसि मायया परया ऽनया ।जीवितं खलु रक्षस्व यदि शक्तो ऽसि वानर ।। ६.५९.८६ ।।।।
transliteration: kape lāghavayukto 'si māyayā parayā 'nayā ।jīvitaṁ khalu rakṣasva yadi śakto 'si vānara ।। 6.59.86 ।।।।

translations.english: And then the night ranger Ravana taking up, fitting the arrow charged with fire, looked at Neela resting on top of the bow.
